headline: Gold and silver both fell sharply today, with 24K gold at ₹13,326 per gram
summary: Today's move is a fall of ₹278 per gram for 24K gold (down 2.04% from ₹13,604 on 17 November) and a drop of ₹5,000 per kg for silver to ₹1,85,000. Compared with 7 days ago, 24K gold is down ₹872 (6.14%) and silver is down ₹15,000 (7.5%). Over the 24 days in our records, gold has fallen 6.65% from ₹14,275, and silver has fallen 15.91% from ₹2,20,000 on 26 October, with today's rates the lowest in that period. International spot prices have eased too, and a stronger US dollar against the rupee (around ₹93.5 per dollar) may also be weighing on prices; these are possible drivers, not confirmed causes.
outlook: If you are buying jewellery or coins, remember that GST and making charges sit on top of these rates, so compare the final bill across jewellers rather than rushing on one day's fall.
